extraction.name: CoNLL-2003 named entity data
extraction.description: A named entity recognition dataset for the CoNLL-2003 shared task covering English and German. It includes training, development, test, and large unannotated files for each language.
extraction.creator: Erik F. Tjong Kim Sang and Fien De Meulder
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was assembled from existing English and German news corpora, split into training, development, test, and large unannotated files. Raw texts were linguistically preprocessed with tokenization, POS tagging, and chunking, and the annotated training/development/test portions were manually named-entity tagged by hand at the University of Antwerp.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw/source data consisted of Reuters news stories for English and German newspaper articles from Frankfurter Rundschau within the ECI Multilingual Text Corpus; additional unannotated raw data were also provided.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: English: articles between August 1996 and August 1997; training/development from the end of August 1996; test from December 1996; raw data from September 1996. German: training/development/test from one week at the end of August 1992; raw data from September to December 1992.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Named entity tagging was performed manually at the University of Antwerp, mostly following MUC conventions, with an additional MISC category for entities not covered by the other categories.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset includes a very broad and heterogeneous MISC entity category, which may introduce labeling inconsistency or category ambiguity.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The data is limited to two languages (English and German), uses predefined train/development/test splits, and relies on prior linguistic preprocessing and annotation conventions, which may constrain generalization and use.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Person names and location names are included as named entities; the dataset covers entity types such as persons, organizations, and locations.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended for named entity recognition system development and evaluation, with training data for learning methods, development data for parameter tuning, test data for evaluation, and unannotated data for incorporation into learning.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Linguistic preprocessing was applied to the raw data: tokenization for all data; English data was POS-tagged and chunked with the MBT tagger; German data was lemmatized, tagged, and chunked with TreeTagger.
